question: 如果四人一起出行，单程机票是980元/人，在酒店住宿一晚上隔天返程，双床房220元一间，则此次观看音乐会的人均花销中，票价占比是多少？

steps.description: Locate the flight details section in the image and read the one-way ticket price per person
Multiply the one-way ticket price from step_1 by 2 to get the round-trip ticket price
Locate the hotel details section in the image and read the double room price per night
Multiply the double room price from step_3 by 2 to get the total hotel cost for 2 rooms
Divide the total hotel cost from step_4 by 4 people to get per capita accommodation cost
Locate the ticket details section in the image and read the concert ticket price
Add the round-trip ticket price from step_2, per capita accommodation cost from step_5, and concert ticket price from step_6 to get total per capita expenditure
Divide the concert ticket price from step_6 by the total per capita expenditure from step_7 to get the ticket price proportion
